finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the video source used for transcription.
Receipt-backed evidence showing the extracted move sequence.
Receipt-backed evidence that /app/solution.txt contains the extracted moves in order.
known_invalid_patterns: Creating /app/solution.txt without deriving it from the video.
Using placeholder, guessed, or partial move lists.
Treating file existence or non-empty output as sufficient without video-derived evidence.
notes: If direct download is unavailable, use any visible accessible method that yields the same video evidence.
contract.objective: Download the referenced YouTube video, transcribe the full on-screen text and player inputs, and create /app/solution.txt containing every move input one per line.
required_artifacts: downloaded video file or equivalent local copy used for transcription
required_behaviors: The video is obtained from the provided URL or an equivalent accessible local copy.
The full contents of the text shown in the video are transcribed from the video evidence.
Every move/input entered by the player is extracted in order and written to /app/solution.txt, one move per line, preserving the exact command text as shown.
verification_plan: Inspect workspace and available tools for a feasible download/transcription path.
Obtain the video locally or via an accessible source.
Extract the move sequence from the video and write /app/solution.txt.
Verify the file contents against the video-derived evidence.
